tools.name: search_destinations
tools.description: Countries and regions with eSIM plans, with the lowest price per currency. Leave query empty to list all.

tools.name: list_plans
tools.description: Plans that work in a country or region, cheapest first, with optional filters for data, days and price.

tools.name: get_plan
tools.description: One plan with prices and every country and mobile network it covers.

tools.name: recommend_plans
tools.description: Plans for a trip to one or more countries: estimates the data needed from the days and how the user uses their phone, then suggests the best-value plans that cover every country for the whole trip.

tools.name: compare_plans
tools.description: Side-by-side comparison of 2 to 5 plans: data, days, price per GB and per day, countries and hotspot.

tools.name: country_networks
tools.description: The mobile networks GLOBALCELL eSIMs use in a country, how many plans work there and the lowest price.

tools.name: check_device
tools.description: Whether a phone, tablet or watch model supports eSIM, from a list of known models, with how to check on the device itself.

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: Creates an order and returns checkoutUrl, the page where the user pays; nothing is charged by this call. Without confirm: true it only returns a preview with the price and creates nothing. Returns orderId and orderToken for check_order.

tools.name: check_order
tools.description: Order status. Once "fulfilled", a new eSIM includes its install links, QR code link and manual codes.

tools.name: check_usage
tools.description: Data used and left on the eSIM of a fulfilled order, per package, with start and expiry dates.

tools.name: diagnose_esim
tools.description: Why an eSIM may not work: line state, every package (started, data left, expired) and the last mobile network the phone registered on, with the likely cause and the fix. For the eSIM of a fulfilled order.

tools.name: install_help
tools.description: Step-by-step eSIM installation and first-use help for iPhone or Android, and fixes for common problems.
